title: AI Build Kit handover v1
description: AI Build Kit owns hosting/handover.json and this schema. AI Host Kit vendors the published release copy unchanged. The config list declares secrets and settings by name only. Requests are defined in $defs/request. Readers accept 1.x; minor versions may add optional fields outside config entries and readers report unknown fields before ignoring them. Config entries remain closed to their descriptive fields in every minor version. After publication, a removal, changed meaning or new required field needs a new major version and a supporting reader update. Free text rejects scheme URLs. Extension keys cannot contain password, passwd, secret, token, key or credential in any letter case. Reference fields accept credential-free HTTPS addresses or repository paths, without queries, fragments, user information, escapes or key text. Validation cannot detect arbitrary secrets disguised as ordinary prose.

items.description: Declare names and where they come from. Never put values here. Secret names are supplied at runtime.

app.description: The app role owns no table and cannot bypass row-level security.

staff.description: Null when no staff directory is used. Null with outsiders none records a template whose sign-in is not configured yet; it does not approve public access.

reference.description: A repository path or HTTPS address without credentials, query, fragment, percent encoding or copied key material. Use an evidence file path instead of a signed address.

oneOf.description: Make an isolated preview of this branch at this commit and return its address and evidence reference.
Return recent redacted logs for the named tool, covering the requested number of minutes.
Check the running tool and return its result and evidence reference.
Put this merged commit live after the host side obtains the required approval and rehearses its migration.

request.description: The four requests to AI Host Kit. A request is intent, not approval. The host owns execution and writes its own records; the build kit never writes host-record.json.

credentialFreeValue.description: Extension values contain no URLs or recognisable key material, and extension keys cannot name secrets. Arbitrary secrets can resemble ordinary prose.
